sfpi register spill: fusing *(1/W) and +eps INTO the rsqrt sqrt-body holds TWO loop-invariant vFloat constants across the body -> sfpi compiler ICE cannot store sfpu register (sfpi_funcs.h:481), even at 4 iterations with #pragma GCC unroll 1. Reformulating: rsqrt(v/W+eps) == sqrt(W)*rsqrt(v+eps*W); when W is a power of 4 the sqrt(W) scale is a FREE exponent add (sfpi::addexp), leaving ONE live constant.
